component: Dark-reader CSS declaration adapter and browser regression task

quotes.text: "The blend mode coming from an embedded rule should be removed"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The adapter adds the literal blend substring to its inline selector and removes a present non-normal mix-blend-mode before returning for styles without color or background properties. Both steps matter for a blend-only inline declaration. Embedded rule styles use the same sanitizer, while normal is left alone. The new fixture/task checks computed normal for an embedded rule and absence of the inline declaration; no visual contrast, external-image behavior or runtime result was established.
title: Blend-only inline styles need both selector reachability and removal before the color guard
